# Assessments

There will be two assessments, both delivered through Canvas, to test your skills and understanding. The format will be multiple choice and numeric answers (based on datasets for you to download and analyse)

-   "formative" assessment, probably mid- to late-November. This does not count towards your mark for NES2504, but will give you practice in using the Canvas system for online assessments. Probably released in late November.
-   "summative" assessment, worth 50% of the course marks. This can be completed in your own time in early December 2026 (date tbc) Again, it is a Canvas-based test. **NOTE** You will have **24 hours** in which to complete the summative assessment. Format will be identical to the formative assessment.
